system.description:
Target's [Magic Power] +3, [Cancel (Undead, Poison): 20]. This effect is treated as a CS. [1D:5 or higher]. This item will not be lost even if used as if it had the [Consumable] tag. A purifying elixir created from the Holy Peach Fruit, which grants protection against impure monsters and allows one to gain abundant magic power by simply swallowing a few drops. When poured into water or tea, it has the flavor of peaches and is delicious, making it a popular delicacy as well.

Immortal Peach [Core Material] (120G) + Ironbody Salve (Basic) (90G) ×2 + Anti-Magic Salve (Basic) (90G) ×2 + [Magic Catalyst 7] (60G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (230G)
